紫.readingDisposition: Full ordered シ/むらさき metadata; linked むらさき practice only. 紫外線 supports compound シ recognition; ゆかり and さい are KANJIDIC2 nanori, historical ツツム remains uncertain. 紫陽花 あじさい is whole-word jukujikun, not an independent 紫 reading. All five keys deliberately tested in bounded host model.
紫.positiveSecondary: JMdict 1311640 color, purple gromwell and soy sauce; complete native source adds colored paper or cloth, sardine, woman, 検校 and specific Edo, Murasaki Shikibu and The Tale of Genji abbreviations. The literary ゆかり relationship is a contextual association, not unconditional lexical synonymy.
紫.restrictions: Complete family 1311640 marks gromwell usually kana; 茈 is a search-only form. Full sense and spelling/read restrictions remain in the retained complete records. Compounds such as 紫陽花 are not reallocated as bare-character readings.
紫.variants: Complete exact 茈, 紫, 此, 糸, 止 and 比 KANJIDIC2 records retained; contains:茈 returns one complete family.
紫.discrepancies: KANJIDIC2 and pinned KanjiVG specify 12 strokes, whereas 字通 capture labels 紫 11; do not reconcile by changing source metadata or geometry.
紫.comparison: 50 expanded baseline scan hits and three curated distinct distractors, evaluated in both directions. Direct exclusions are symmetric and non-transitive; broad precautions are not universal synonyms.

externalCaptures: Reused B132 survey captures with exact raw/text hashes; full captures stay local.
limits: Author assessment only, finite scan, not independent review or publication acceptance.
